node.label: obsolete hypomyelination-hypogonadotropic hypogonadism-hypodontia syndrome
node.definition: OBSOLETE. Hypomyelination-hypogonadotropic hypogonadism-hypodontia syndrome is characterized by the association of demyelinating leukodystrophy with progressive cerebellar ataxia, hypogonadotropic hypogonadism and hypodontia.
